rows.translation: 12 tahdin blues A:ssa, nopea vaihto, boogie-bassolinja, käännös ja ensimmäiset blues-lickisi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 “Blues” · unit summary

rows.source: The blues in A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · title

rows.source: One, four, five
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
rows.translation: Bluesin soinnut rakentuvat sävellajin ensimmäiselle, neljännelle ja viidennelle sävelelle. E:ssä ne ovat E7, A7 ja B7. A:han siirryttäessä niistä tulee A7, D7 ja E7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
rows.translation: Mikä sointu hoitaa A:ssa saman tehtävän kuin B7 E:ssä?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
rows.translation: B7 on viisi kirjainta E:stä ylöspäin. A:sta viisi kirjainta ylös on E, joten E7 ottaa sen paikan.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Twelve bars in A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
rows.translation: Neljä tahtia A7:ää, kaksi D7:ää, kaksi A7:ää ja sitten tahti kutakin: E7, D7, A7 ja E7. Viimeinen E7 kääntää takaisin alkuun.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The quick change
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · title

rows.source: Visit the four chord early
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
rows.translation: Nopeassa vaihdossa tahti 2 hyppää neljännen asteen sointuun ja suoraan takaisin. A:ssa: A7, D7, A7, A7. Se tuo liikettä heti alkuun.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a quick change in A, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Mikä sointu on tahdissa 2 A:n nopeassa vaihdossa?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
rows.translation: A:n neljännen asteen sointu on D7. Nopea vaihto käy siinä tahdissa 2 ja palaa sitten A7:ään.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Now in E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.
rows.translation: Nopea vaihto toimii kaikissa sävellajeissa. E:ssä: E7, A7, E7, E7. Varaudu lopun lähellä B7:ään, neljän sormen sointuusi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A boogie bass line
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · title

rows.source: Walk the chord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
rows.translation: Boogie-linja nousee sointua ylös ja takaisin, kukin sävel kahdesti, pitkä-lyhyt kuten shufflessa. A7:n päällä se nousee A, ylennetty C, E, ylennetty F, G ja laskee sitten takaisin.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.
rows.translation: Vapaa A, kielen 5 nauha 4, kielen 4 nauhat 2 ja 4, sitten vapaa G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Boogie in A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How do the two notes of each pair feel?
rows.translation: Miltä kunkin parin kaksi säveltä tuntuvat?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Exactly even
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It's the shuffle again: a long note on the beat, a short one just before the next.
rows.translation: Taas shuffle: pitkä sävel iskulla, lyhyt juuri ennen seuraavaa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Move it to D and E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same walk starts from D on string 4 and from E on string 6. Over D7: D, F sharp, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G sharp, B, C sharp, D.
rows.translation: Sama kulku alkaa D:stä kielellä 4 ja E:stä kielellä 6. D7:n päällä: D, ylennetty F, A, B, C. E7:n päällä: E, ylennetty G, B, ylennetty C, D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Boogie in D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Boogie in E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Boogie, A to D and back
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.source: A lick that turns you around
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bars 11 and 12 often get a turnaround, a short lick that leads back to the top. This one walks down from A to E, one fret at a time.
rows.translation: Tahdeissa 11 ja 12 on usein käännös, lyhyt lick, joka johtaa takaisin alkuun. Tämä kulkee A:sta alas E:hen nauha kerrallaan.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: fret 2, fret 1, then open.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 4: fret 4, then 3, then 2. Let the E ring.
rows.translation: Kieli 4: nauha 4, sitten 3, sitten 2. Anna E:n soida.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does a turnaround usually go?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Bars 1 and 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bars 11 and 12
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bars 5 and 6
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The last two bars. It leads the ear back to bar 1 for another time around.
rows.translation: Kahteen viimeiseen tahtiin. Se johdattaa korvan takaisin tahtiin 1 uudelle kierrokselle.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Ten bars, then the lick
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum the first ten bars with the quick change, then switch to the lick for bars 11 and 12. That's how a blues band ends each time around.
rows.translation: Komppaa ensimmäiset kymmenen tahtia nopealla vaihdolla ja vaihda sitten lickiin tahdeissa 11 ja 12. Näin bluesyhtye päättää jokaisen kierroksen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Blues licks in A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · title

rows.source: The pentatonic meets the blues
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your A minor pentatonic box fits right over a blues in A. Its C rubs against the C sharp in A7, and that rub is the sound of the blues.
rows.translation: A-mollipentatoninen kuviosi sopii suoraan A-bluesiin. Sen C hankaa A7:n ylennettyä C:tä vasten, ja juuri tuo hankaus on bluesin soundi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Over a blues in A, which note sounds most like home?
rows.translation: Mikä sävel tuntuu A-bluesissa eniten kodilta?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A is the root of the key. Licks that end on A sound settled; G and C leave you hanging.
rows.translation: A on sävellajin perussävel. A:han päättyvät lickit kuulostavat vakailta; G ja C jättävät ilmaan.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Call and answer
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Blues phrases talk to each other. Play lick 1 as the question, then answer with lick 2, which lands on the low A.
rows.translation: Bluesfraasit keskustelevat keskenään. Soita lick 1 kysymyksenä ja vastaa lickillä 2, joka päätyy matalaan A:han.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Question and answer
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Blues licks, up to speed
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.source: Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · title

rows.source: Funk on one chord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Neon Laundromat on Timbre-alkuperäiskappale: yhden soinnun, A7:n, varassa kulkevaa funkia. Koukku liukuu C:stä ylennettyyn C:hen, kuten blues-lickiesi hankaus, ja kertosäe putoaa E7:ään. Koko kappale on Kappaleet-osion Alkuperäiskappaleissa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, then open E.
rows.translation: A kielen 3 nauhalla 2, sitten C ja ylennetty C kielen 2 nauhoilla 1 ja 2, sitten vapaa E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Over A7, which note rubs against the chord?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C sharp
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A7 is A, C sharp, E and G. C, from your pentatonic box, rubs against its C sharp, and the hook slides from one to the other.
rows.translation: A7 koostuu sävelistä A, ylennetty C, E ja G. Pentatonisen kuvion C hankaa sen ylennettyä C:tä vasten, ja koukku liukuu niiden välillä.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Boogie, played straight
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Neon Laundromat doesn't shuffle. Play your boogie walk in even eighths and it becomes a bass line under the A7: A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, and back down.
rows.translation: Neon Laundromat ei käytä shufflea. Soita boogie-kulku tasaisina kahdeksasosina, niin siitä tulee A7:n bassolinja: A, ylennetty C, E, ylennetty F, G ja takaisin alas.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Twelve bars, your way
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: the 12-bar in A and E, the quick change, the boogie line, the turnaround and your licks. Keep the shuffle swinging.
rows.translation: Ei uutta: 12 tahdin blues A:ssa ja E:ssä, nopea vaihto, boogie-linja, käännös ja lickisi. Pidä shuffle keinuvana.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a quick change in E, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Mikä sointu on tahdissa 2 E:n nopeassa vaihdossa?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Boogie, all 12 bars
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Lead technique
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · title

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends and vibrato, and a second pentatonic box.
rows.translation: Hammer-onit, pull-offit, slidet, bendit ja vibrato sekä toinen pentatoninen kuvio.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · unit summary

rows.source: Hammer-ons
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · title

rows.source: Sound a note without picking
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A hammer-on sounds a second note with the fretting hand alone. Pick a note, then bring another finger down hard, just behind a higher fret. The string keeps ringing.
rows.translation: Hammer-on tuottaa toisen sävelen pelkällä otelautakädellä. Näppäile sävel ja lyö toinen sormi napakasti ylemmän nauhan taakse. Kieli jatkaa soimista.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pick open string 3, then hammer finger 2 onto fret 2. Don't pick the second note.
rows.translation: Näppäile vapaa kieli 3 ja lyö sormi 2 nauhalle 2. Älä näppäile toista säveltä.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 3: pick fret 5 with finger 1, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 7.
rows.translation: Kieli 3: näppäile nauha 5 sormella 1 ja lyö sormi 3 nauhalle 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What makes a hammer-on ring clearly?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Picking both notes hard
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A fast, firm landing right behind the fret
rows.translation: Nopea, napakka osuma aivan nauhan taakse
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Pressing finger 1 harder
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.
rows.translation: Nopeus ja tarkkuus merkitsevät voimaa enemmän. Osu sormenpäällä aivan nauhan taakse, niin kieli jatkaa lauluaan.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Hammer-ons in box 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: A phrase with hammer-ons
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Pull-offs
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · title

rows.source: Hammer-ons in reverse
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
rows.translation: Pull-off laskee alempaan säveleen. Pidä molemmat sormet painettuina, näppäile ylempi sävel ja nykäise sitten ylempi sormi sivulle niin, että se näppäilee kieltä irrotessaan.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
rows.translation: Nauha 2 kielellä 3, sitten nykäise sormi 2 irti, jotta vapaa G soi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
rows.translation: Sormet 1 ja 3 nauhoilla 5 ja 7. Näppäile ja vedä sitten sormi 3 irti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In a pull-off, the top finger…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lifts straight up
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stays down
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flicks off sideways, plucking the string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lifting straight up lets the note die. A small sideways flick plucks the lower note into life.
rows.translation: Suoraan nostaminen sammuttaa sävelen. Pieni sivunyökkäys näppäilee alemman sävelen eloon.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pull-offs in box 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Hammer, then pull
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Slides
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · title

rows.source: Glide to the next note
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
rows.translation: Slidessa näppäilet sävelen ja pidät paineen samana liu'uttaessasi samaa sormea uudelle nauhalle. Paine kantaa äänen; vain ensimmäinen sävel näppäillään.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
rows.translation: Sormi 3 kielen 3 nauhalle 7. Näppäile ja liu'u nauhalle 9 nostamatta sormea.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Picking again at the end
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Steady pressure as you glide
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A lighter touch
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ease off and the note dies. Keep the same pressure all the way to the new fret.
rows.translation: Jos hellität, sävel sammuu. Pidä paine samana uudelle nauhalle asti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
rows.translation: Nyt takaisin: näppäile nauha 9 ja liu'u nauhalle 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A phrase with a slide
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Slide, up to speed
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Bends and vibrato
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · title

rows.source: Bend to a target
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
rows.translation: Bend työntää kieltä nauhan poikki ja nostaa sävelkorkeutta. Kokoaskeleen eli kahden nauhan bendin nauhalta 7 pitää soida täsmälleen kuin nauha 9.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
rows.translation: Kieli 3, nauha 9: tämä on bendin kohdesävel. Anna sen soida ja paina se mieleen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Three fingers push
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
rows.translation: Aseta sormi 3 nauhalle 7 sekä sormet 1 ja 2 sen taakse samalle kielelle. Työnnä kaikkia kolmea kattoa kohti ja kierrä rannetta kuin ovennuppia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
rows.translation: Bend nauhalta 7 soi nauhaa 9 matalammalta. Mitä teet?

rows.source: Lead over a reggae groove
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Saltwater Sunday on Timbre-alkuperäiskappale: rentoa reggaeta A-mollissa, Am7 ja D7 vuorotahdein. Molemmat pentatoniset kuviot sopivat niihin. Käytä hammer-oneja, pull-offeja ja slideja. Osu sointusäveleen tahdin alussa. Koko kappale on Kappaleet-osion Alkuperäiskappaleissa.

rows.source: The E shape moves

rows.source: F is only the start
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
rows.translation: F-barré on E-ote ja barré nauhalla 1. Liu'uta koko otetta, niin nimi seuraa kielen 6 perussäveltä: nauhalla 3 se on G, nauhalla 5 A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
rows.translation: Kieli 6 nousee E:stä: F nauhalla 1, G nauhalla 3, A nauhalla 5. Barrén nauha antaa soinnulle nimen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Minor: lift finger 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
rows.translation: Nosta sormi 2 ja anna barrén painaa kieltä 3. Se on E-molliote, ja se liikkuu samoin: ylennetty F-molli nauhalla 2, A-molli nauhalla 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A shape, root on string 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
rows.translation: B-molli oli A-molliote barrélla. Myös A-duuriote liikkuu: paina barréna kielet 1–5 ja aseta sitten sormi 3 poikittain kielille 4, 3 ja 2 kaksi nauhaa ylemmäs.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Kieli 5 nousee A:sta: B nauhalla 2, C nauhalla 3, D nauhalla 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The minor A shape moves too
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
rows.translation: Käytä molliin B-mollin sormia: 2, 3 ja 4 rakentavat A-mollin kuvion barrén eteen. Nauhalla 3 se on C-molli.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Useimmat soinnut voi soittaa E-otteella, perussävel kielellä 6, tai A-otteella, perussävel kielellä 5. Valitse se, joka on lähempänä kättäsi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Smooth barre changes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · title

rows.source: Relax between chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
rows.translation: Hellitä barréa hetkeksi liikkuessasi ja purista vasta laskeutuessasi. Jatkuva kova puristus väsyttää kättä ja hidastaa vaihtoa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: All the time
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only as the chord lands
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Never
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
rows.translation: Purista asettuessa, rentoudu liikkuessa. Jatkuva voima väsyttää käden minuuteissa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Strum through the move
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
rows.translation: Nosta barré viimeisellä ylöslyönnillä ennen vaihtoa ja jatka komppaamista. Vapaat kielet soivat hetken, rytmi ei pysähdy ja osut ajoissa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is a Timbre Original: indie pop in E on E, B, C sharp minor and A. B and C sharp minor are both A-shape barres, two frets apart, so one hand shape does most of the work. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Spray Paint Sunrise on Timbre-alkuperäiskappale: indiepoppia E-duurissa soinnuilla E, B, ylennetty C-molli ja A. B ja ylennetty C-molli ovat A-otteen barréita kahden nauhan päässä, joten yksi ote tekee suuren työn. Koko kappale on Kappaleet-osion Alkuperäiskappaleissa.

rows.source: Four to a beat

rows.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
rows.translation: Kuudestoistaosat jakavat iskun neljään: yk-si-ja-ja, kak-si-ja-ja. Komppikäsi tuplaa vauhtinsa: alas-ylös-alas-ylös jokaisen iskun sisällä.

rows.translation: Kuinka monta kuudestoistaosaa täyttää yhden iskun?

rows.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
rows.translation: Yk-si-ja-ja: neljä tasaista osaa jokaiselle iskulle.

rows.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
rows.translation: Funk rakastaa noonisointua. Sormi 2 kielen 5 nauhalle 7, sormi 1 kielen 4 nauhalle 6 ja sormi 3 poikittain kielille 3, 2 ja 1 nauhalle 7.

rows.source: Mute, then hit
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Pidä käsi liikkeessä kuudestoistaosina, mutta hellitä otelautasormia niin, että useimmat lyönnit ovat kuivia, raapivia naksahduksia. Paina vain soivia iskuja varten.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What makes a scratch?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Strumming with your palm
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Plucking with your thumb
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
rows.translation: Kosketus ilman painamista estää kieliä soimasta. Lyönnistä tulee terävä, rytminen naksahdus.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Short hits, and D9
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
rows.translation: Purista jokaiselle iskulle ja rentouta heti, jotta ääni jää lyhyeksi. Liu'uta koko E9-ote kaksi nauhaa alas, niin saat D9:n.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Reggae: the offbeat chop
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · title

rows.source: Chop on two and four
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
rows.translation: Reggaekitara vastaa rummuille lyhyillä, kirkkailla soinnuilla kakkos- ja nelosiskuilla. Komppaa vain ohuita kieliä ja katkaise jokainen sointu heti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Small, high shapes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
rows.translation: Käytä vain neljää ylintä kieltä. Tämä A-molli on nauhan 5 A-mollibarrén yläosa: sormi 3 kielen 4 nauhalla 7, sormi 1 barréna muilla.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: As long as possible
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Barely at all
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Exactly one beat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
rows.translation: Purista, lyö, vapauta. Isku on lyhyt haukahdus, ja sen jälkeinen tila luo grooven.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D, up top
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
rows.translation: Nyt D-barrén yläosa: sormi 3 poikittain kielille 4, 3 ja 2 nauhalle 7, sormi 1 kielen 1 nauhalle 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Country boom-chick
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · title

rows.source: Bass, strum, bass, strum
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
rows.translation: Countryrytmi jakaa tahdin: yksi bassosävel ykkösellä ja kolmosella, nopea ohuiden kielten sointu kakkosella ja nelosella. Bum, tsäk, bum, tsäk.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The booms in G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
rows.translation: Mitä basso-sointu-kompissa tapahtuu kakkosella ja nelosella?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A single bass note
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A short strum of the thin strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Nothing at all
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Alternate the bass
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
rows.translation: Siirrä toinen bassoisku toiselle kielelle: G:ssä kieli 6 ja sitten kieli 4. C:ssä kieli 5 ja sitten 4. D:ssä kieli 4 ja sitten vapaa kieli 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Booms in G, C and D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: The syncopated pop strum
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · title

rows.source: Skip the downbeats
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
rows.translation: Synkopointi sijoittaa lyönnin odottamattomaan kohtaan. Alas ykkösellä, ylös kakkosen ja-tavulla, ylös kolmosen ja-tavulla, sitten alas-ylös nelosella.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
rows.translation: Mitä käsi tekee tässä kuviossa kakkosiskulla?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Strums down hard
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Swings down past the strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
rows.translation: Heiluri ei pysähdy. Kakkosella käsi heiluu alas koskematta kieliin, valmiina ylöslyöntiin.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Change a little early
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
rows.translation: Popsoittajat vaihtavat usein sointua viimeisellä ylöslyönnillä, nelosen ja-tavulla, jolloin uusi sointu saapuu aavistuksen etuajassa. Se työntää kappaletta eteenpäin.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Song spotlight: Sparkler Season
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · title

rows.source: The pop strum on four chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sparkler Season is a Timbre Original: a summer anthem in C on C, G, A minor and F. Give it the syncopated pop strum, and change a hair early, on the and of four. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Sparkler Season on Timbre-alkuperäiskappale: kesähitti C-duurissa soinnuilla C, G, A-molli ja F. Soita synkopoitua popkomppia ja vaihda aavistuksen etuajassa nelosen ja-tavulla. Koko kappale on Kappaleet-osion Alkuperäiskappaleissa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open E and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, then G at fret 3 on string 1, and back down to D.
rows.translation: Vapaa E ja D kielen 2 nauhalla 3 kahdesti, sitten G kielen 1 nauhalla 3 ja takaisin alas D:hen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Why change chords on the and of four?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: So the new chord rings on beat one
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: To slow the song down
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: To skip a chord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Moving on the last up strum gets your hand there a hair early, so the new chord is ready for beat one.
rows.translation: Viimeisellä ylöslyönnillä liikkuminen vie käden perille hieman aikaisin, joten uusi sointu on valmis ykkösiskulle.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Rhythm styles challenge
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · title

rows.source: Four grooves, one hand
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: funk sixteenths, the reggae chop, boom-chick and the syncopated pop strum. Keep the hand swinging and change only what it hits.
rows.translation: Ei uutta: funk-kuudestoistaosat, reggae-iskut, basso-sointu-komppi ja synkopoitu popkomppi. Pidä käsi liikkeessä ja muuta vain sitä, mihin se osuu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Reggae chops land on which beats?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: One and three
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two and four
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Every beat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Putting it together
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 “Putting it together” · title

rows.source: A capo, G and D shapes on capo 2, and Oh! Susanna arranged with a verse and a chorus.
rows.translation: Capo, G- ja D-otteet capolla 2 sekä Oh! Susanna sovitettuna säkeistöksi ja kertosäkeeksi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 “Putting it together” · unit summary

rows.source: The capo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · title

rows.source: A clamp across the neck
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A capo clamps every string at one fret. On fret 2, each open string sounds two frets higher, and your open chord shapes all move up with it.
rows.translation: Capo puristaa jokaisen kielen yhdeltä nauhalta. Nauhalla 2 jokainen vapaa kieli soi kaksi nauhaa korkeammalta, ja avoimet sointuotteet nousevat mukana.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Before the capo: pluck strings 1 and 2 open. That's E and B.
rows.translation: Ennen capoa: näppäile vapaat kielet 1 ja 2. Ne ovat E ja B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now clamp the capo just behind fret 2 and pluck them again: F sharp and C sharp.
rows.translation: Kiinnitä nyt capo aivan nauhan 2 taakse ja näppäile uudelleen: ylennetty F ja ylennetty C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. You play a G shape. Which chord sounds?
rows.translation: Capo nauhalla 2. Soitat G-otteen. Mikä sointu soi?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two frets up from G is A. The shape stays G; the sound moves up with the capo.
rows.translation: Kaksi nauhaa G:stä ylös on A. Ote pysyy G:nä, mutta ääni nousee capon mukana.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Think in shapes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: With a capo you still think G, C and D, the shapes you know. The diagrams here name the chord you actually hear, so a G shape on capo 2 reads A.
rows.translation: Capolla ajattelet yhä tuttuja otteita G, C ja D. Kaaviot nimeävät tässä oikeasti kuulemasi soinnun, joten G-ote capolla 2 näkyy A:na.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G and D shapes on capo 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · title

rows.source: The G family, two frets up
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On capo 2, G, C, D and E minor shapes sound as A, D, E and F sharp minor. Same fingers, new key: A major.
rows.translation: Capolla 2 otteet G, C, D ja E-molli soivat A:na, D:nä, E:nä ja ylennettynä F-mollina. Samat sormet, uusi sävellaji: A-duuri.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A D shape sounds as…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two frets above D is E.
rows.translation: Kaksi nauhaa D:n yläpuolella on E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The D family
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: D shapes work the same way. On capo 2, D, G and A shapes sound as E, A and B: the key of E with easy open fingerings.
rows.translation: D-otteet toimivat samoin. Capolla 2 otteet D, G ja A soivat E:nä, A:na ja B:nä: E-duuri helpoilla avoimilla sormituksilla.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Oh! Susanna: the verse
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · title

rows.source: Verse, then chorus
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most songs alternate two sections. The verse tells the story; the chorus repeats the hook. Stephen Foster's Oh! Susanna (1848) has both. Capo off: it's in G.
rows.translation: Useimmat kappaleet vuorottelevat kahta osaa. Säkeistö kertoo tarinan, kertosäe toistaa koukun. Stephen Fosterin Oh! Susanna (1848) sisältää molemmat. Capo pois: sävellaji on G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The pickup and first bar: open G, A at fret 2, then open B, D at fret 3 twice, and open E.
rows.translation: Koho ja ensimmäinen tahti: vapaa G, A nauhalla 2, sitten vapaa B, D nauhalla 3 kahdesti ja vapaa E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which section usually comes back with the same words?
rows.translation: Mikä osa palaa yleensä samoilla sanoilla?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The intro
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Verses change their words as the story moves on. The chorus returns unchanged, and that's what people sing along to.
rows.translation: Säkeistöjen sanat vaihtuvat tarinan edetessä. Kertosäe palaa muuttumattomana, ja juuri sitä lauletaan mukana.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Chords under the verse
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Back the verse with G and D7, boom-chick style: bass on one, strum on two. Three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Säestä säkeistöä G:llä ja D7:llä basso-sointu-tyyliin: basso ykköselle, sointu kakkoselle. Kolme tahtia G:tä, yksi D7:ää, kaksi G:tä, sitten D7 ja G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The verse, flowing
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.source: Oh! Susanna: the chorus
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · title

rows.source: The hook starts higher
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The chorus opens on C, string 2, fret 1, then jumps to open E. Its chords are C, G and D7, and its second half matches the verse's ending.
rows.translation: Kertosäe alkaa C:stä kielen 2 nauhalla 1 ja hyppää vapaaseen E:hen. Soinnut ovat C, G ja D7, ja jälkipuolisko vastaa säkeistön loppua.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: C twice on string 2, fret 1, then open E three times.
rows.translation: Alku: C kahdesti kielen 2 nauhalla 1, sitten vapaa E kolmesti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Then down: D twice, open B, open G, and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Sitten alas: D kahdesti, vapaa B, vapaa G ja A nauhalla 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The three E's go short, long, short. Where does the long one start?
rows.translation: Kolme E:tä ovat lyhyt, pitkä, lyhyt. Mistä pitkä alkaa?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On the beat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Halfway through the beat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It starts on the and and rings across the next beat. That push is syncopation, like your pop strum.
rows.translation: Se alkaa ja-tavulta ja soi seuraavan iskun yli. Tuo ennakointi on synkopointia, kuten popkompissasi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Your arrangement
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · title

rows.source: Plan the song
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An arrangement decides what you play, and when. Yours: a Travis-picked intro, the verse as melody, the chorus strummed boom-chick, then the chorus melody to finish.
rows.translation: Sovitus päättää, mitä soitat ja milloin. Sinun sovituksesi: Travis-näppäilty alku, säkeistön melodia, kertosäe basso-sointu-komppina ja lopuksi kertosäkeen melodia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Intro: Travis on G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: What does an intro do?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Sets the key and tempo before the melody
rows.translation: Asettaa sävellajin ja tempon ennen melodiaa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Replaces the verse
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Repeats the chorus words
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A few bars of chords tell everyone where home is and how fast to go.
rows.translation: Muutama tahti sointuja kertoo kaikille, missä koti on ja kuinka nopeasti edetään.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Verse: the melody
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: End on the hook
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finish with the chorus melody and let the last G ring. Ending on the tune everyone just heard feels complete.
rows.translation: Päätä kertosäkeen melodiaan ja anna viimeisen G:n soida. Juuri kuultuun sävelmään päättäminen tuntuu kokonaiselta.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is a Timbre Original: dance-hall country in A, on A, D and E. Clamp the capo on fret 2 and play it with G, C and D shapes, the ones you know best. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Gravel Road Two-Step on Timbre-alkuperäiskappale: tanssilavacountrya A:ssa soinnuilla A, D ja E. Kiinnitä capo nauhalle 2 ja soita parhaiten tuntemillasi G-, C- ja D-otteilla. Koko kappale on Kappaleet-osion Alkuperäiskappaleissa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. Which shape sounds as E?
rows.translation: Capo nauhalla 2. Mikä ote soi E:nä?

rows.source: Two frets above D is E. On capo 2 the G shape gives A, and the C shape gives D.
rows.translation: Kaksi nauhaa D:n yläpuolella on E. Capolla 2 G-ote antaa A:n ja C-ote D:n.

rows.source: Pick the chord's root on beats one and three, and strum on two and four, each with a quick up after it. Boom, chick-a, boom, chick-a: the dancers' steps.
rows.translation: Näppäile soinnun perussävel ykkösellä ja kolmosella, komppaa kakkosella ja nelosella ja lisää heti perään nopea ylöslyönti. Bum, tsäkä, bum, tsäkä: tanssijoiden askeleet.

rows.source: Five open shapes become five places to play G, and chords that stay near your hand.
rows.translation: Viidestä avoimesta otteesta viisi tapaa soittaa G sekä soinnut lähellä kättäsi.

rows.source: One chord, five shapes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · title

rows.source: CAGED: five shapes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major chord can borrow the shape of open C, A, G, E or D, moved up the neck. Climbing from any one, the shapes come in that order, C A G E D, and each locks onto the next.
rows.translation: Jokainen duurisointu voi lainata avoimen C:n, A:n, G:n, E:n tai D:n otetta siirrettynä kaulalla ylemmäs. Mistä tahansa noustessa otteet seuraavat järjestystä C A G E D, ja kukin liittyy seuraavaan.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: CAGED is named after…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Five frets
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Five open chord shapes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Five strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C, A, G, E and D: the five open shapes that every major chord can borrow, anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: C, A, G, E ja D: viisi avointa otetta, joita jokainen duurisointu voi lainata missä tahansa kaulalla.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Next up: the E shape
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Climb from open G and the next shape is the E shape: your G barre at fret 3. Its root on string 6 is the same G as in the open chord.
rows.translation: Nouse avoimesta G:stä, niin seuraava on E-ote: G-barré nauhalla 3. Sen perussävel kielellä 6 on sama G kuin avoimessa soinnussa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Same chord or different?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: The D shape at fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open D moved up five frets is G. Finger 1 holds string 4 at fret 5, where the nut used to be. Fingers 2, 4 and 3 rebuild the D triangle above it.
rows.translation: Avoin D viisi nauhaa ylempänä on G. Sormi 1 painaa kieltä 4 nauhalta 5, jossa satula aiemmin oli. Sormet 2, 4 ja 3 rakentavat D-kolmion sen yläpuolelle.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The D shape, string by string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Where is the D shape's root?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 1, under finger 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 3, under finger 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 4, under finger 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Open D's root is open string 4. Moved up, finger 1 holds it: G at fret 5. String 2, fret 8 is a G too.
rows.translation: Avoimen D:n perussävel on vapaa kieli 4. Siirretyssä otteessa sormi 1 painaa sitä: G nauhalla 5. Myös kielen 2 nauha 8 on G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A shared note
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The E shape at fret 3 and the D shape at fret 5 share one note: G on string 4, fret 5. Keep your eyes on it as you move between them.
rows.translation: E-otteella nauhalla 3 ja D-otteella nauhalla 5 on yhteinen sävel: G kielen 4 nauhalla 5. Pidä se silmissäsi vaihtaessasi otteiden välillä.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The C shape at fret 7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open C moved up seven frets is G. Finger 1 lies across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7, finger 2 takes string 2 at fret 8, and fingers 3 and 4 stretch to strings 4 and 5.
rows.translation: Avoin C seitsemän nauhaa ylempänä on G. Sormi 1 painaa poikittain kieliä 3, 2 ja 1 nauhalla 7, sormi 2 kieltä 2 nauhalla 8, ja sormet 3 ja 4 kurottavat kielille 4 ja 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The C shape, string by string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Like open C, the C shape's root is on…
rows.translation: Kuten avoimessa C:ssä, C-otteen perussävel on…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Open C's root is string 5, fret 3. Here your little finger holds it: G at fret 10.
rows.translation: Avoimen C:n perussävel on kielen 5 nauhalla 3. Tässä pikkusormi painaa sitä: G nauhalla 10.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Any chord, same shape
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Slide the C shape down to fret 2 and it's D, with its root on string 5, fret 5. The name always follows the root.
rows.translation: Liu'uta C-ote alas nauhalle 2, niin saat D:n, jonka perussävel on kielen 5 nauhalla 5. Nimi seuraa aina perussäveltä.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The A shape, and around again
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · title

rows.source: The A shape at fret 10
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 10 and lay finger 3 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 12. It's your A-shape barre, and it's G again.
rows.translation: Paina barréna kieliä 5–1 nauhalla 10 ja aseta sormi 3 poikittain kielille 4, 3 ja 2 nauhalle 12. Se on A-otteen barré ja jälleen G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 12 starts the cycle again
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Past the A shape, the G shape comes back at fret 12: open G, one octave higher. From there the five shapes repeat in the same order.
rows.translation: A-otteen jälkeen G-ote palaa nauhalla 12: avoin G oktaavia ylempänä. Siitä viisi otetta toistuvat samassa järjestyksessä.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Going up the neck, which shape comes after A?
rows.translation: Mikä ote seuraa A:ta kaulalla ylöspäin?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The order loops: C, A, G, E, D, then C again. After A comes G.
rows.translation: Järjestys kiertää: C, A, G, E, D ja taas C. A:n jälkeen tulee G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which G is higher?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Chords near your hand
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · title

rows.source: Stay in one spot
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: With CAGED you rarely have to jump. Around fret 5, G is the D shape, C is the G shape and D is the A shape. Three chords, one spot.
rows.translation: CAGEDin avulla tarvitsee harvoin hypätä. Nauhan 5 ympärillä G on D-ote, C on G-ote ja D on A-ote. Kolme sointua samassa kohdassa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which shape plays C right beside the D-shape G?
rows.translation: Millä otteella C soitetaan aivan D-otteisen G:n vieressä?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right where your hand already is.
rows.translation: C:n G-ote käyttää nauhoja 5 ja 8 juuri siellä, missä kätesi jo on.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Or stay at fret 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same idea works lower: G as the E shape at fret 3, C as the A shape at fret 3, and D as the C shape at fret 2.
rows.translation: Sama ajatus toimii alempana: G E-otteella nauhalla 3, C A-otteella nauhalla 3 ja D C-otteella nauhalla 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Song spotlight: Lantern Hill
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · title

rows.source: One song, three places
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a Timbre Original: a campfire sing-along on G, C and D. Play its chorus open, then near fret 5, then near fret 3, and the same song moves around the neck. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Lantern Hill on Timbre-alkuperäiskappale: nuotion yhteislaulu soinnuilla G, C ja D. Soita kertosäe avoimena, sitten nauhan 5 ja nauhan 3 lähellä. Sama kappale liikkuu kaulalla. Koko kappale on Kappaleet-osion Alkuperäiskappaleissa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Near fret 5, which shape plays C?
rows.translation: Millä otteella C soitetaan nauhan 5 lähellä?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right beside the D-shape G and the A-shape D.
rows.translation: C:n G-ote käyttää nauhoja 5 ja 8, aivan D-otteisen G:n ja A-otteisen D:n vieressä.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The chorus, picked at fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · title

rows.source: Five shapes, one neck
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: G in all five shapes, and G, C and D near fret 3 and fret 5. Name each shape as you land it.
rows.translation: Ei uutta: G kaikilla viidellä otteella sekä G, C ja D nauhojen 3 ja 5 lähellä. Nimeä ote aina asettaessasi sen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G with the D shape sits at…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Triads up the neck
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · title

rows.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
rows.translation: Kolmen sävelen soinnut yläkielillä: duuri, molli, kaikki käännökset ja lähes liikkumattomat kierrot.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · unit summary

rows.source: Triads on the top strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · title

rows.source: Three notes make a chord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: Kolmisointu on pienin täysi sointu: perussävel, terssi ja kvintti. Kielillä 3, 2 ja 1 kolmisoinnut soivat selkeinä ja kirkkaina ja toimivat kaikkialla kaulalla.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, root at the bottom
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which notes make a C major triad?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C, E and G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C, D and E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C, F and A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
rows.translation: Perussävel, terssi, kvintti: C:stä jätä kirjain väliin E:hen, sitten toinen G:hen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Same notes, new order
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
rows.translation: Siirrä alin sävel ylimmäksi, niin saat käännöksen. E alimpana C on nauhoilla 9, 8 ja 8. G alimpana se on avoimen C:n yläosa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Inversions of G and D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · title

rows.source: Three shapes for every chord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
rows.translation: Jokainen duurikolmisointu näillä kielillä käyttää yhtä kolmesta otteesta, yhtä kullekin käännökselle. Opettele ne G:llä ja D:llä, niin löydät minkä tahansa duurisoinnun.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
rows.translation: G nauhoilla 4, 3 ja 3 käyttää samaa otetta kuin…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C at frets 5, 5 and 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C at frets 9, 8 and 8
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: No other chord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
rows.translation: Molemmissa terssi on alimpana: kieli 3 nauhan ylempänä, kaksi muuta samalla tasolla. Sama ote viiden nauhan päässä.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D, twice
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
rows.translation: D nauhoilla 7, 7 ja 5 on samassa perusasemassa kuin C nauhalla 5. Alempana nauhat 2, 3 ja 2 ovat avoimen D:n yläosa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Minor triads
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · title

rows.source: Lower the third
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
rows.translation: Mollikolmisointu on duurikolmisointu, jonka terssi on nauhan alempana. Näillä kielillä A-molli nauhoilla 2, 1 ja 0 on avoimen A-mollin yläosa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A minor at fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
rows.translation: Paina barréna nauhaa 5 kielillä 3, 2 ja 1, niin saat A-mollin C alimpana. Yksi sormi, kolme säveltä.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E minor beside it
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
rows.translation: E-mollissa nauhoilla 4, 5 ja 3 B on alimpana. Se on aivan nauhan 5 A-mollin vieressä, joten vaihto on pieni.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Triads through a progression
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · title

rows.source: Move to the nearest shape
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
rows.translation: Valitse kättä lähinnä oleva käännös, niin kierto tuskin liikkuu. G, E-molli, C ja D löytyvät kaikki nauhojen 2 ja 5 välistä.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
rows.translation: G:stä nauhoilla 4, 3, 3 E-molliin nauhoilla 4, 5, 3: mitkä sävelet pysyvät?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Only D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B and G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
rows.translation: B kielellä 3 ja G kielellä 1 pysyvät paikallaan. Vain kieli 2 liikkuu D:stä ylös E:hen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Higher up the neck
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
rows.translation: Samat neljä sointua ovat myös ylempänä: G nauhoilla 7, 8 ja 7, E-molli nauhoilla 9, 8 ja 7, C nauhoilla 9, 8 ja 8 sekä D nauhoilla 7, 7 ja 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Triad arpeggios
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · title

rows.source: Pick them apart
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
rows.translation: Soita kolmisoinnun sävelet yksi kerrallaan, niin saat arpeggion. Sointukierron läpi kulkiessaan sävelet muodostavat oman melodiansa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Listen to the top
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
rows.translation: Ylimmät sävelet kulkevat tässä G, G, G, ylennetty F: lähes paikallaan sointujen vaihtuessa alla. Kahden soinnun jakama sävel on yhteinen sävel, ja se tekee kolmisoinnuista niin sulavia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Song spotlight: Roller Rink
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · title

rows.source: Triads on the dance floor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Roller Rink on Timbre-alkuperäiskappale: retrotanssipoppia soinnuilla G, E-molli, C ja D, neljällä kolmisoinnullasi nauhojen 2 ja 5 välissä. Pienet yläkielten otteet soivat kirkkaina ja napakoina kuin toinen kitara. Koko kappale on Kappaleet-osion Alkuperäiskappaleissa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
rows.translation: Roller Rinkin kierto on G:n yksi, kuusi, neljä ja viisi. Mikä sointu on kuusi?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
rows.translation: Laske G-duuria: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. Asteen 6 sointu on molli: E-molli.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
