rows.source: No new ideas: major and minor triads, their inversions, G, E minor, C and D in two places, and the arpeggios. Keep every move small.
rows.translation: Ei uutta: duuri- ja mollikolmisoinnut, niiden käännökset, G, E-molli, C ja D kahdessa kohdassa sekä arpeggiot. Pidä kaikki liikkeet pieninä.

rows.source: Major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, the ii–V–I, and swing comping.
rows.translation: Suuret, pienet ja dominanttiseptimit avoimina ja barréina, ii–V–I sekä swing-komppaus.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 “Seventh chords and jazz voicings” · unit summary

rows.source: Major seventh chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · title

rows.source: Add the seventh
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
rows.translation: Suuri duuriseptimisointu lisää sävelen, joka on nauhan perussävelen oktaavin alapuolella. Se tekee tavallisesta duurista pehmeän ja unenomaisen. Avoin Cmaj7 on C, josta sormi 1 on nostettu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
rows.translation: Mikä sävel lisätään C:hen, jotta saadaan Cmaj7?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B flat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
rows.translation: Suuri septimi on nauhan perussävelen oktaavin alapuolella: B aivan C:n alla.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Fmaj7: free the top string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
rows.translation: Soita pieni F, mutta anna sormen 1 painaa vain kieltä 2. Vapaa kieli 1, E, on F:n suuri septimi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Minor seventh chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · title

rows.source: Mellow minor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
rows.translation: Molliseptimisointu lisää sävelen kaksi nauhaa perussävelen oktaavin alapuolelta. Se soi pehmeästi tumman ja kirkkaan välimaastossa. Am7 on A-molli, josta sormi 3 on nostettu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Dm7 and Em7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
rows.translation: Dm7: sormi 2 kielen 3 nauhalle 2, sormi 1 poikittain kielille 2 ja 1 nauhalle 1. Em7: vain sormi 2 kielen 5 nauhalle 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
rows.translation: Mikä sävel lisätään A-molliin, jotta saadaan Am7?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
rows.translation: Pieni septimi on kaksi nauhaa perussävelen oktaavin alapuolella: G kaksi nauhaa A:n alla.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · title

rows.source: Cmaj7 at fret 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
rows.translation: Sormi 1 painaa kieltä 5 nauhalta 3 ja ulottuu kielelle 1. Sormi 3 hoitaa kielen 4, sormi 2 kielen 3 ja sormi 4 kielen 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Dm7 and D7 at fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
rows.translation: Dm7 on A-mollibarré pikkusormi nostettuna. D7 on A-otteen barré, jossa sormet 3 ja 4 ovat kielillä 4 ja 2. Molemmat saavat nimensä kielestä 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
rows.translation: Dm7 nauhalla 5. Missä sen perussävel on?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 4, fret 7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 5, fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 1, fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
rows.translation: Kuten kaikki A-otteen soinnut, se saa nimensä kielen 5 sävelestä.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The ii–V–I
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · title

rows.source: Two, five, one
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
rows.translation: Jazzin suosikkikulku: sävellajin toisen sävelen sointu, sitten viidennen ja lopuksi kotiin. C:ssä ne ovat Dm7, G7 ja Cmaj7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G7 as a barre
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
rows.translation: Soita E7-ote barréna nauhalla 3: sormi 1 kaikkien kuuden kielen poikki, sormi 3 kielelle 5 ja sormi 2 kielelle 3. Perussävel on kielellä 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
rows.translation: Laske C:stä: C on yksi, D on kaksi. D:lle rakennettu septimisointu on D-molliseptimi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Short and crisp
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
rows.translation: Jazzsoittajat antavat usein soinnun soida vain hetken. Purista lyödessäsi ja hellitä heti perään, niin soinnut alkavat svengata.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Swing comping
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · title

rows.source: The Charleston
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
rows.translation: Swingkitaristit komppaavat lyhyillä soinnuilla, jotka vastaavat yhtyeelle. Charleston-rytmi osuu ykkösiskulle ja kakkosen svengaavalle ja-tavulle ja jättää sitten tilaa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: ii–V–I in G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
rows.translation: G:ssä kaksi, viisi, yksi on Am7, D7 ja Gmaj7. Am7 on E-molliseptimibarré nauhalla 5. Gmaj7 jättää kielen 5 pois, ja sen perussävel on kielen 6 nauhalla 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Song spotlight: Late Checkout
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · title

rows.source: A ii–V–I on a loop
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Late Checkout on Timbre-alkuperäiskappale: lo-fi C:ssä soinnuilla Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 ja Am7. Se on ii–V–I ja kuudennen asteen sointu uudelle kierrokselle. Komppaa septimibarréilla ja Charlestonilla. Koko kappale on Kappaleet-osion Alkuperäiskappaleissa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Late Checkout, which chord is the V?
rows.translation: Mikä sointu on Late Checkoutin V?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
rows.translation: Laske C-duuria: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. G:n septimisointu on G7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · title

rows.source: Sevenths, swung
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.
rows.translation: Ei uutta: suuret, pienet ja dominanttiseptimit avoimina ja barréina sekä ii–V–I C:ssä ja G:ssä. Pidä soinnut lyhyinä ja swing tasaisena.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Mikä septimi on nauhan perussävelen oktaavin alapuolella?

rows.source: The major scale in position
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · title

rows.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.
rows.translation: G-duuri kahdessa oktaavissa nauhalla 2, asteikon asteet ja soinnut sekä doorinen ja miksolyydinen moodi.

rows.source: The major scale shape
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · title

rows.source: Whole steps and half steps
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
rows.translation: Puolisävelaskel on yksi nauha, kokoaskel kaksi. Jokainen duuriasteikko nousee koko, koko, puoli, koko, koko, koko, puoli. Tämä kaava antaa duurille sen soinnin.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G major at fret 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
rows.translation: Aseta sormi 1 nauhalle 2 ja anna jokaiselle sormelle oma nauha nauhaan 5 asti. Asteikko nousee kielen 6 nauhan 3 G:stä kielten 6, 5 ja 4 kautta.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
rows.translation: Kieli 6: nauhat 3 ja 5, sormet 2 ja 4. Kieli 5: nauhat 2 ja 3, sormet 1 ja 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
rows.translation: Kielen 5 nauha 5, sitten kieli 4: nauhat 2, 4 ja 5. Kotiin G:hen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Between notes 3 and 4, and 7 and 8
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Between every pair
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Between notes 1 and 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Koko, koko, puoli: ensimmäinen puolisävelaskel on 3:sta 4:ään. Koko, koko, koko, puoli: toinen on 7:stä 8:aan.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: One octave, up and down
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Two octaves in position
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · title

rows.source: The second octave
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
rows.translation: Sama asema jatkuu: A, B ja C kielellä 3, D ja E kielellä 2, ylennetty F ja G kielellä 1. Käsi ei liiku lainkaan.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
rows.translation: Kieli 3: nauhat 2, 4, 5. Kieli 2: nauhat 3, 5. Kieli 1: nauhat 2, 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The top octave
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: In this position, which finger plays fret 5?
rows.translation: Mikä sormi soittaa nauhan 5 tässä asemassa?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
rows.translation: Sormi 1 on nauhalla 2, joten nauha 5 kuuluu sormelle 4, pikkusormelle.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Two octaves, G to G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: A carol built on the scale
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
rows.translation: Lowell Masonin vuonna 1839 sovittama Joy to the World alkaa G-duuriasteikolla suoraan ylhäältä alas. Tunnet jo jokaisen sävelen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Joy to the World, in position
rows.translation: Joy to the World samassa asemassa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Scale degrees and chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · title

rows.source: Number the notes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
rows.translation: Numeroi asteikko G:stä: G on 1, A on 2 ja niin edelleen ylennettyyn F:ään, 7:ään. Muusikot käyttävät numeroita puhuessaan melodioista ja soinnuista missä tahansa sävellajissa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which note is 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.translation: Laske G:stä: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A chord on every note
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
rows.translation: Pinoa joka toisesta asteikkosävelestä sointu kullekin asteelle. Asteiden 1, 4 ja 5 soinnut ovat duureja; asteiden 2, 3 ja 6 molleja. G:ssä: G, C ja D, sitten A-molli, B-molli ja E-molli.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
rows.translation: Kuudes sävel on E, ja asteiden 2, 3 ja 6 soinnut ovat molleja. Pinoa E, G ja B: E-molli.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The scale in thirds
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: A Dorian
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · title

rows.source: Same notes, new home
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
rows.translation: Soita G-duurin sävelet mutta pidä A:ta kotina, niin asteikko muuttuu molliseksi. Tämä on A-doorinen, G-duurin moodi: sama asema, uusi aloitussävel.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
rows.translation: Aloita A:sta kielen 6 nauhalla 5 sormella 4 ja nouse samoja nauhoja kielen 3 A:han.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
rows.translation: Mikä sävel tekee A-doorisesta tavallista A-mollia kirkkaamman?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F sharp
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
rows.translation: Tavallisessa A-mollissa on F. Doorinen säilyttää G-duurin ylennetyn F:n: kirkkaan kohdan molliasteikossa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A Dorian melody
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: A Dorian melody, flowing
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: D Mixolydian
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · title

rows.source: Start on D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Pidä nyt D:tä kotina. G-duurin sävelet D:stä D:hen muodostavat D-miksolyydisen: duuriasteikon, jonka septimi on nauhan alempana. Sitä kuulee folkissa, rockissa ja viulusävelmissä.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Kielen 5 nauhan 5 D:stä samaa asemaa ylös kielen 2 nauhan 3 D:hen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
rows.translation: D-duurissa on ylennetty C. D-miksolyydisessä on…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.
rows.translation: Miksolyydinen laskee septimiä nauhan, joten G-duurin C on sen tunnussävel.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D Mixolydian melody
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Mode by mode
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Any note of the major scale can be home. From G it's major, from A Dorian, from D Mixolydian, from E plain minor. Same frets, different moods.
rows.translation: Mikä tahansa duuriasteikon sävel voi olla koti. G:stä se on duuri, A:sta doorinen, D:stä miksolyydinen, E:stä tavallinen molli. Samat nauhat, eri tunnelmat.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D Mixolydian, twice
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Song spotlight: Market Day
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · title

rows.source: A hook in second position
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Market Day is a Timbre Original: sunny pop in G with a highlife bounce, the bright guitar music of West Africa. Its hook uses only G major's notes, so it sits inside your second-position scale. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Market Day on Timbre-alkuperäiskappale: aurinkoista poppia G:ssä, Länsi-Afrikan kirkkaan kitaramusiikin highlife-keinunnalla. Koukku käyttää vain G-duurin säveliä, joten se sopii toisen aseman asteikkoon. Koko kappale on Kappaleet-osion Alkuperäiskappaleissa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Market Day's chords are G, B minor, C and D. Which scale degrees are they on?
rows.translation: Market Dayn soinnut ovat G, B-molli, C ja D. Millä asteilla ne ovat?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G is 1, B is 3, C is 4 and D is 5. The chord on 3 is minor in every major key: B minor.
rows.translation: G on 1, B on 3, C on 4 ja D on 5. Asteen 3 sointu on molli jokaisessa duurissa: B-molli.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, B at fret 4 on string 3, D again, E at fret 5 with finger 4, then D and B.
rows.translation: D kielen 2 nauhalla 3, B kielen 3 nauhalla 4, taas D, E nauhalla 5 sormella 4, sitten D ja B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Scale challenge
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · title

rows.source: One position, three moods
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: G major in two octaves, the scale in thirds, A Dorian and D Mixolydian. Keep one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Ei uutta: G-duuri kahdessa oktaavissa, asteikko tersseinä, A-doorinen ja D-miksolyydinen. Pidä yksi sormi kullakin nauhalla.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half spells…
rows.translation: Koko, koko, puoli, koko, koko, koko, puoli muodostaa…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Mikä moodi alkaa G-duurin toisesta sävelestä?

rows.source: Major pentatonic and expressive lead
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 “Major pentatonic and expressive lead” · title

rows.source: The major pentatonic, country hammer-ons and slides, trills, phrasing, and sweet and sour over the blues.
rows.translation: Duuripentatoninen, countryn hammer-onit ja slidet, trillit, fraseeraus sekä bluesin makea ja hapan.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 “Major pentatonic and expressive lead” · unit summary

rows.source: The major pentatonic
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · title

rows.source: Slide the box down
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
rows.translation: Siirrä mollipentatoninen kuviosi nauhalta 5 nauhalle 2 ja pidä A:ta kotina: se muuttuu makeaksi duuriksi. Se on A-duuripentatoninen: A, B, ylennetty C, E ja ylennetty F.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From A on string 6, fret 5, then frets 2 and 4 on strings 5 and 4, and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: A kielen 6 nauhalla 5, sitten nauhat 2 ja 4 kielillä 5 ja 4 sekä A kielen 3 nauhalla 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which notes are in A major pentatonic?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, E, F sharp
rows.translation: A, B, ylennetty C, E, ylennetty F
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Five notes of the A major scale, its two half steps left out. The minor box at fret 5 holds A, C, D, E and G.
rows.translation: Viisi A-duuriasteikon säveltä, kaksi puolisävelaskelta jätetty pois. Mollikuvio nauhalla 5 sisältää sävelet A, C, D, E ja G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A major pentatonic, up and down
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: One box, two keys
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: This box at fret 2 is also F sharp minor pentatonic, from its F sharp. The note you treat as home decides which one you're playing.
rows.translation: Tämä kuvio nauhalla 2 on myös ylennetty F-mollipentatoninen sen ylennetystä F:stä alkaen. Kotina pitämäsi sävel ratkaisee, kumpaa soitat.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Country hammer-ons and slides
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · title

rows.source: Hammer into the major
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
rows.translation: Countrysoittajat rakastavat hammer-oneja tämän kuvion sisällä: E:stä ylennettyyn F:ään kielellä 4, A:sta B:hen kielellä 3. Näppäile ensimmäinen sävel ja lyö toinen sormella.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
rows.translation: Kieli 4: näppäile nauha 2 ja lyö sormi 3 nauhalle 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Lick 1: two hammer-ons
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Slide up to C sharp
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
rows.translation: Liu'uta nyt sormi 3 kielen 3 nauhalta 4 nauhalle 6, B:stä ylennettyyn C:hen, ja palaa sitten liukuen kuvioon.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
rows.translation: Sormi 3 kielen 3 nauhalle 4. Näppäile ja liu'u nauhalle 6 nostamatta sormea.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Lick 2: the slide
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Both licks
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.source: Trills and slides into notes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · title

rows.source: A trill
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
rows.translation: Trilli värähtelee kahden sävelen välillä: yksi näppäily, sitten hammer-on ja pull-off yhä uudelleen. Tee siitä tasainen ennen nopeuttamista.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
rows.translation: Kieli 3: nauhat 2 ja 4. Näppäile kerran, sitten hammer-on ja pull-off sormella 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A slow trill
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Trills on strings 3 and 4
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Slide into a note
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
rows.translation: Aloita nauha tavoitesävelen alapuolelta ja liu'u siihen näppäillessäsi. Kohdesävel ratkaisee: osu siihen täsmälleen iskulla.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When you slide into a note, which one lands on the beat?
rows.translation: Kun liu'ut säveleen, kumpi osuu iskulle?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The target
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The fret below
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both at once
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The slide starts just before the beat, so the note you're aiming for arrives right on it.
rows.translation: Liuku alkaa juuri ennen iskua, jotta tavoittelemasi sävel saapuu täsmälleen iskulle.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sweet and sour
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · title

rows.source: Two boxes, one blues
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Over a blues in A, both boxes work. Major pentatonic at fret 2 sounds sweet; minor at fret 5 sounds tough. Good players move between them.
rows.translation: A-bluesissa molemmat kuviot toimivat. Duuripentatoninen nauhalla 2 soi makeasti; molli nauhalla 5 rouheasti. Hyvät soittajat liikkuvat niiden välillä.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sweet, at fret 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Sour, at fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which box sounds sweeter over A7?
rows.translation: Kumpi kuvio soi makeammin A7:n päällä?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A major, at fret 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A minor, at fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
rows.translation: Duuripentatoninen sisältää ylennetyn C:n, A7:n terssin. Mollikuvion C hankaa sitä vasten, ja juuri tuo hankaus on bluesia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sour, then sweet
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Ask a tough question at fret 5, then answer it sweetly at fret 2. Shift your hand on the long note, and land both phrases on A.
rows.translation: Kysy rouhea kysymys nauhalla 5 ja vastaa makeasti nauhalla 2. Siirrä kättä pitkän sävelen aikana ja päätä molemmat fraasit A:han.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Question and answer, flowing
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Phrase like a singer
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · title

rows.source: Leave space
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Great solos breathe. Play a short phrase, rest about as long as it lasted, then answer. The silence makes the next notes count.
rows.translation: Hyvät soolot hengittävät. Soita lyhyt fraasi, lepää suunnilleen yhtä kauan ja vastaa sitten. Hiljaisuus antaa seuraaville sävelille painoa.

rows.source: How songs are built
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · title

rows.source: Sections
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
rows.translation: Useimmat kappaleet koostuvat muutamasta osasta: tarinaa kertovista säkeistöistä, koukkua toistavasta kertosäkeestä ja joskus vastakohtaa tuovasta väliosasta. Rakenteen tunteminen pitää sinut kartalla.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What does a chorus usually carry?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The hook everyone sings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The guitar solo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The chorus returns with the same words and tune. It's the part people remember and sing along to.
rows.translation: Kertosäe palaa samalla tekstillä ja melodialla. Se on osa, jonka ihmiset muistavat ja laulavat mukana.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
rows.translation: Monissa vanhoissa kappaleissa on AABA: sävelmä, sama uudelleen, erilainen väliosa ja vielä sama sävelmä. Osat ovat usein kahdeksan tahdin mittaisia; tässä ne ovat neljän.

rows.source: Intros and endings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · title

rows.source: Borrow the last line
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.
rows.translation: Helpoin alkusoitto on kappaleen viimeinen säe ennen ensimmäistä säkeistöä. Se asettaa sävellajin, tempon ja tunnelman, ja laulaja tietää täsmälleen, milloin tulla mukaan.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The tag
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: To end, repeat the last line, often twice more, and let the final chord ring. A tag tells everyone the song is closing.
rows.translation: Lopeta toistamalla viimeinen säe, usein vielä kahdesti, ja anna viimeisen soinnun soida. Lopputoisto kertoo kaikille, että kappale päättyy.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Arrangers lift a chorus by changing what the guitar does. Fingerpick the verse softly, then strum the chorus, and the same chords suddenly sound bigger.
rows.translation: Sovittaja nostaa kertosäettä muuttamalla kitaran tehtävää. Näppäile säkeistö pehmeästi sormin, komppaa sitten kertosäe, niin samat soinnut kuulostavat äkkiä suuremmilta.

rows.translation: Down by the Riverside: oma sovitus
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · title

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, a spiritual first printed in 1918, gets the full treatment: a Travis-picked intro, two verses and choruses, a pentatonic solo, and a tag.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, ensi kerran vuonna 1918 painettu spirituaali, saa täyden sovituksen: Travis-alkusoitto, kaksi säkeistöä ja kertosäettä, pentatoninen soolo ja lopputoisto.

rows.source: The solo uses G major pentatonic in open position: G, A, B, D and E. It follows the verse's chords and ends a beat early, so the singer can come back in.
rows.translation: Soolo käyttää G-duuripentatonista avoimessa asemassa: G, A, B, D ja E. Se seuraa säkeistön sointuja ja päättyy iskun etuajassa, jotta laulaja pääsee takaisin mukaan.

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Jukebox Moon on Timbre-alkuperäiskappale: viisikymmenluvun hidas tanssi AABA-muodossa, säkeistö, sama uudelleen, väliosa F:llä ja taas säkeistö. Komppaa joka iskulla ja lisää nopea svengaava ylöslyönti ennen uutta tahtia. Koko kappale on Kappaleet-osion Alkuperäiskappaleissa.

rows.source: On most instruments the strings get lower as you go up. On ukulele, string 4 (G) is higher than string 3 (C). This is called re-entrant tuning.
rows.translation: Useimmissa soittimissa kielet madaltuvat ylöspäin mentäessä. Ukulelessa kieli 4 (G) on korkeampi kuin kieli 3 (C). Tätä kutsutaan re-entrant-viritykseksi.

rows.source: Which chord shares finger 1's spot on string 2 with B flat?
rows.translation: Missä soinnussa sormi 1 on samalla kohdalla kielellä 2 kuin alennetussa B:ssä?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F also puts finger 1 on string 2, fret 1. Keep it there as you change.
rows.translation: Myös F:ssä sormi 1 on kielen 2 nauhalla 1. Pidä se siinä vaihtaessasi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D7 and the key of G
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · title

rows.source: D7: a barre and one finger
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 2, and put finger 2 on string 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: Aseta sormi 1 kielten 4, 3 ja 2 poikki nauhalle 2 ja sormi 2 kielen 1 nauhalle 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The key of G
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
rows.translation: G:ssä soinnut G, C ja D7 tekevät suurimman työn, E-molli tuo tummempaa väriä. D7 vetää G:hen kuten G7 C:hen.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B minor and the key of D
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · title

rows.source: Bm: one flat finger
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
rows.translation: Aseta sormi 1 kielten 3, 2 ja 1 poikki nauhalle 2 ja kurota sormi 3 kielen 4 nauhalle 4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
rows.translation: Millä kielillä sekä D että B-molli painavat nauhaa 2?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Strings 4 and 1
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only string 1
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Strings 3 and 2
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
rows.translation: Molemmat soinnut painavat nauhaa 2 kielillä 3 ja 2. Vain uloimmat kielet muuttuvat.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The key of D
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
rows.translation: D:ssä soinnut D, G ja A7 kantavat kappaleen, ja B-molli tuo surullisen sävyn. A7 tarvitsee yhden sormen: kieli 3, nauha 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Same numbers, new key
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · title

rows.source: Songs travel by numbers
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
rows.translation: Kappaleen soinnut ovat sävellajin asteita: I, IV ja V. Sävellaji vaihtuu, numerot pysyvät. C:ssä ne ovat C, F ja G7; G:ssä G, C ja D7; F:ssä F, alennettu B ja C7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from F: F, G, A, B flat. The fourth note is B flat.
rows.translation: Laske F:stä: F, G, A, alennettu B. Neljäs sävel on alennettu B.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pick the singer's key
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: If a song sits too high or too low to sing, move it to another key. Same numbers, same song, just a better fit for the voice.
rows.translation: Jos kappale on liian korkea tai matala laulettavaksi, siirrä se toiseen sävellajiin. Samat numerot, sama kappale, mutta äänelle sopivampi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of D, which chord is V?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from D: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note, so A7 is the V chord.
rows.translation: Laske D:stä: D, E, ylennetty F, G, A. A on viides sävel, joten A7 on V-sointu.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: G minor and minor keys
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · title

rows.source: Gm: three fingers
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 2, fret 3, and finger 1 on string 1, fret 1. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Sormi 2 kielen 3 nauhalle 2, sormi 3 kielen 2 nauhalle 3 ja sormi 1 kielen 1 nauhalle 1. Kieli 4 soi vapaana.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The key of D minor
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: D minor's family is D minor, G minor and A7. A7 pulls home to D minor, the way E7 pulls to A minor.
rows.translation: D-mollin perhe on D-molli, G-molli ja A7. A7 vetää kotiin D-molliin kuten E7 A-molliin.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Challenge: new keys
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · title

rows.source: Four keys, one hand
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, and the keys of C, G, F and D. Clean shapes first, then a steady strum.
rows.translation: Ei uutta: alennettu B, D7, B-molli ja G-molli sekä sävellajit C, G, F ja D. Ensin puhtaat otteet, sitten tasainen komppi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of G, which chord is V?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Strum styles
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · title

rows.source: The chunk, the island strum with a backbeat, swing and the ragtime chords, accents in 3-3-2, and the waltz.
rows.translation: Vaimennusisku, takapotkuinen saarikomppi, swing, ragtime-soinnut, 3-3-2-aksentit ja valssi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · unit summary

rows.source: The chunk
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · title

rows.source: A strum that clicks
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A chunk is a strum that stops dead. Strum down and let the side of your palm land on the strings at the same moment: a short, dry click, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Vaimennusisku pysähtyy kuin seinään. Lyö alas ja laske kämmenen reuna kielille samalla hetkellä: lyhyt, kuiva naksahdus kuin virvelirumpu.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Down, chunk, down-up, chunk
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum down on 1, chunk on 2, down-up on 3, chunk on 4. The chunks fall where a drummer hits the snare.
rows.translation: Alas iskulla 1, vaimennus iskulla 2, alas-ylös iskulla 3, vaimennus iskulla 4. Vaimennusiskut osuvat rumpalin virvelin kohdille.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where do the chunks land?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Beats 2 and 4
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beats 1 and 3
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only on 1
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two and four are the backbeat, where the snare drum plays. A chunk there gives the strum a drummer's punch.
rows.translation: Kakkonen ja nelonen ovat takapotku, jossa virveli soi. Vaimennusisku siinä antaa kompille rumpalin napakkuutta.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Island strum with a chunk
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · title

rows.source: Swap one down for a chunk
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Take the island strum, D, DU, UDU, and turn the down on 2 into a chunk. The rhythm stays the same; the groove gets a backbeat.
rows.translation: Ota saarikomppi D, DU, UDU ja muuta iskun 2 alaslyönti vaimennusiskuksi. Rytmi pysyy samana, groove saa takapotkun.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this strum, which stroke becomes the chunk?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The up after 2
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The down on 2
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 rings out, beat 2 clicks. Everything else stays where the island strum had it.
rows.translation: Isku 1 soi, isku 2 naksahtaa. Kaikki muu pysyy saarikompin paikoilla.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Swing and the ragtime chords
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · title

rows.source: Swing splits each beat unevenly: a long down, then a short up. Say hum-pty, dum-pty as you strum. It's the bounce of old ukulele tunes.
rows.translation: Swing jakaa iskun epätasaisesti: pitkä alas, lyhyt ylös. Sano tam-ta, tam-ta kompatessasi. Se on vanhojen ukulelesävelmien pomppu.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The ragtime progression
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, A7, D7, G7, then home to C. Each seventh chord pulls to the next, a little chain of tension. It powered countless songs a century ago.
rows.translation: C, A7, D7, G7 ja kotiin C:hen. Jokainen septimisointu vetää seuraavaan, pienenä jänniteketjuna. Se kantoi lukemattomia kappaleita vuosisata sitten.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord does D7 pull toward here?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 leads to G, and G7 leads home to C. Each chord sets up the next.
rows.translation: D7 johtaa G:hen ja G7 kotiin C:hen. Jokainen sointu valmistelee seuraavaa.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Accents in 3-3-2
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · title

rows.source: Push the and of 2
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum steady down-up eighths, but hit three of them harder: 1, the and of 2, and 4. The accents fall 3, 3 and 2 eighths apart.
rows.translation: Komppaa tasaisia alas-ylös-kahdeksasosia, mutta lyö kolme kovempaa: 1, iskun 2 ja-tavu ja 4. Aksenttien väli on 3, 3 ja 2 kahdeksasosaa.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which eighths get the accents?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: 1, the and of 2, and 4
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1 and 3
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 across the bar's eight eighths. Each 1 is an accent.
rows.translation: Laske tahdin kahdeksan kahdeksasosaa 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2. Jokainen 1 on aksentti.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Where it comes from
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: George Formby's split stroke on the banjo ukulele puts its big strums in the same three places, with single strings in between. Master the accents first.
rows.translation: George Formbyn banjoukulelen split stroke -tekniikassa suuret lyönnit ovat samoissa kolmessa kohdassa ja välissä soivat yksittäiset kielet. Hallitse ensin aksentit.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Waltz strums
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · title

rows.source: Three beats, down-up
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In three, strum down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: D, DU, DU. Lean on 1 so the sway is clear.
rows.translation: Kolmessa lyö alas iskulla 1 ja alas-ylös iskuilla 2 ja 3: D, DU, DU. Painota iskua 1, jotta keinunta kuuluu.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many strums fill this bar of three?
rows.translation: Kuinka monta lyöntiä täyttää tämän kolmen iskun tahdin?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: one plus two plus two.
rows.translation: Alas iskulla 1, alas-ylös iskuilla 2 ja 3: yksi plus kaksi plus kaksi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Challenge: strum styles
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · title

rows.source: Five grooves
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: chunks, the island strum with a chunk, swing, the 3-3-2 accents and the waltz. Keep the hand moving and let the accents speak.
rows.translation: Ei uutta: vaimennusiskut, saarikomppi vaimennuksella, swing, 3-3-2-aksentit ja valssi. Pidä käsi liikkeessä ja anna aksenttien puhua.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a swing strum, each beat splits into…
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Fingerpicking and chord melody
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · title

rows.source: One finger per string, rolling patterns, the alternating thumb, and a tune picked from inside its chords.
rows.translation: Sormi kullekin kielelle, rullaavat kuviot, vuorotteleva peukalo ja melodia sointujen sisältä.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · unit summary

rows.source: One finger per string
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · title

rows.source: A finger for each string
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rest your thumb on string 4, index on string 3, middle on string 2 and ring finger on string 1. Each one plucks only its own string.
rows.translation: Aseta peukalo kielelle 4, etusormi kielelle 3, keskisormi kielelle 2 ja nimetön kielelle 1. Kukin näppäilee vain omaa kieltään.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring: strings 4, 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Peukalo, etusormi, keskisormi, nimetön: kielet 4, 3, 2 ja 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which finger plucks string 1?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Thumb on 4, index on 3, middle on 2, ring on 1: one finger per string.
rows.translation: Peukalo 4:llä, etusormi 3:lla, keskisormi 2:lla, nimetön 1:llä: yksi sormi kieltä kohti.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: C, string 4 to string 1
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: A zigzag, not a ladder
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Because string 4 is a high G, the pattern zigzags: high, low, then climbing. That sparkle is the sound of fingerpicked ukulele.
rows.translation: Koska kieli 4 on korkea G, kuvio kulkee siksakkia: korkea, matala ja sitten nousu. Tuo helke on sormin näppäillyn ukulelen soundi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A minor, F, C, G7
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: A minor, F, C, G7, in eighths
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Rolling patterns
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · title

rows.source: Out and back
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pluck strings 4, 3, 2 and 1, then come back on 2 and 3: thumb, index, middle, ring, middle, index. Six notes fill a bar of three.
rows.translation: Näppäile kielet 4, 3, 2 ja 1 ja palaa sitten kielillä 2 ja 3: peukalo, etusormi, keskisormi, nimetön, keskisormi, etusormi. Kuusi säveltä täyttää kolmen iskun tahdin.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, out and back
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: After the ring finger plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Mikä sormi tulee nimettömän näppäiltyä kieltä 1?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The middle
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The index
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: ring on string 1, then middle on 2 and index on 3.
rows.translation: Kuvio kääntyy ylimpänä: nimetön kielellä 1, sitten keskisormi 2:lla ja etusormi 3:lla.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Change on the thumb
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Land the new chord as the thumb starts the next bar. The fingers keep rolling; only the shape under them changes.
rows.translation: Aseta uusi sointu peukalon aloittaessa seuraavan tahdin. Sormet jatkavat rullausta, vain niiden alla oleva ote muuttuu.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, A minor, D minor, G7
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: The alternating thumb
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · title

rows.source: Thumb on every beat
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now the thumb rocks between strings 3 and 4 on the beats while your fingers pluck strings 2 and 1 in between. It's the ukulele's version of Travis picking.
rows.translation: Peukalo vuorottelee nyt kielten 3 ja 4 välillä iskuilla, kun muut sormet näppäilevät kieliä 2 ja 1 välissä. Tämä on ukulelen versio Travis-näppäilystä.

rows.source: C, add the fingers

rows.source: Melody inside the chord

rows.source: Hold the chord, pick the tune
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In chord melody, your fretting hand holds the chord and you pick the tune from inside it. Hold F, and C, F and A are already under your fingers.
rows.translation: Sointumelodiassa otelautakäsi pitää soinnun ja näppäilet melodian sen sisältä. Ota F, niin C, F ja A ovat jo sormiesi alla.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hold F: open string 3, string 2 at fret 1, open string 1. That's how Amazing Grace begins.
rows.translation: Pidä F: vapaa kieli 3, kielen 2 nauha 1, vapaa kieli 1. Näin Amazing Grace alkaa.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Add a free finger
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the tune leaves the chord, reach with a free finger. Over F, finger 3 takes G on string 2, fret 3, then lifts as the tune comes back.
rows.translation: Kun melodia poistuu soinnusta, kurota vapaalla sormella. F:n päällä sormi 3 ottaa G:n kielen 2 nauhalta 3 ja nousee melodian palatessa.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3, fret 2
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B flat's finger 2 already holds D on string 3, fret 2. The tune walks right through the chord.
rows.translation: Alennetun B:n sormi 2 pitää jo D:tä kielen 3 nauhalla 2. Melodia kulkee suoraan soinnun läpi.

rows.translation: Murtosoinnut säkeistöjen välissä ja melodia sointujen sisällä. Sävelmä on vuonna 1829 painettu virsi New Britain, sanoittajana John Newton.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The verse starts a beat early, on its pickup. A long last note keeps that beat clear.
rows.translation: Säkeistö alkaa iskun etuajassa koholla. Pitkä viimeinen sävel jättää tuon iskun vapaaksi.

rows.source: Four public-domain songs arranged for ukulele, and how to lead a room through them.
rows.translation: Neljä ukulelelle sovitettua tekijänoikeusvapaata kappaletta ja yhteislaulun johtaminen.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 “Campfire to stage” · unit summary

rows.source: A spiritual for a crowd
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, first printed in 1918, is made for singing together. On ukulele it sits in G, with G, C and D7, and a gospel A sharp on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: Vuonna 1918 ensi kertaa painettu Down by the Riverside on tehty yhdessä laulamiseen. Ukulelella se on G:ssä soinnuilla G, C ja D7 sekä gospelmaisella ylennetyllä A:lla kielen 1 nauhalla 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, ylennetty A, B, sitten A ja G.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A ballad to pick
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Cecil Sharp printed this English ballad in 1906. In F it uses F, B flat, C and C7, G minor and D minor, often two to a bar. Pick the chords between verses and let them ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp painoi tämän englantilaisen balladin vuonna 1906. F:ssä se käyttää F:ää, alennettua B:tä, C:tä ja C7:ää, G-mollia ja D-mollia, usein kahta tahtiin. Näppäile soinnut säkeistöjen välissä ja anna niiden soida.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The water is wide: open string 3, F at fret 1 twice, G at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: The water is wide: vapaa kieli 3, F nauhalla 1 kahdesti, G nauhalla 3, sitten vapaa A.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Two chords in a bar
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
rows.translation: Monet tahdit vaihtavat tässä puolivälissä. Laske säkeistö kahden iskun puolikkaina, yksi sointu kuhunkin, ja vaihda joka toisella naksahduksella.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Traditional (Cecil Sharp, 1906)
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: Lead the singalong
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · title

rows.source: Count everyone in
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before the first strum, count out loud at the song's tempo: one, two, three, four. Everyone starts together, at the speed you set.
rows.translation: Laske ennen ensimmäistä lyöntiä ääneen kappaleen tempossa: yksi, kaksi, kolme, neljä. Kaikki aloittavat yhdessä asettamallasi nopeudella.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Keep going, no matter what
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Miss a chord? Keep strumming and catch the next one. A singing room follows the beat, not every note.
rows.translation: Menikö sointu ohi? Jatka komppaamista ja ota seuraava kiinni. Laulava yleisö seuraa sykettä, ei jokaista säveltä.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You fumble a change mid-song. What now?
rows.translation: Sointuvaihto epäonnistuu kesken kappaleen. Mitä teet?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Keep strumming and catch the next chord
rows.translation: Jatkan komppia ja otan seuraavan soinnun
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stop and start over
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Slow down until it's fixed
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The beat carries everyone. Drop a chord if you must, never the rhythm.
rows.translation: Syke kantaa kaikkia. Jätä tarvittaessa sointu pois, älä koskaan rytmiä.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Signal the end
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before the last line, nod or call out last time. Slow the final line a touch and let the last chord ring.
rows.translation: Nyökkää tai huuda ”viimeinen kerta” ennen viimeistä säettä. Hidasta loppusäettä hieman ja anna viimeisen soinnun soida.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Dublin's song, in three
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Molly Malone was printed in 1876. It's a waltz: lean on beat 1 and let the tune sway. In F it uses F, G minor, C7, D minor and G7.
rows.translation: Molly Malone painettiin vuonna 1876. Se on valssi: painota iskua 1 ja anna melodian keinua. F:ssä se käyttää F:ää, G-mollia, C7:ää, D-mollia ja G7:ää.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open string 3, F at fret 1 four times, open A, back to F.
rows.translation: In Dublin's fair city: vapaa kieli 3, F nauhalla 1 neljästi, vapaa A, takaisin F:ään.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest back to F?
rows.translation: Mikä sointu vetää voimakkaimmin takaisin F:ään?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G minor
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C7 is the V chord in F. Its seventh leans straight back home.
rows.translation: C7 on F:n V-sointu. Sen septimi vetää suoraan kotiin.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Traditional (printed 1876; James Yorkston, 1884)
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: Six counts, two sways
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This rowing song is in six-eight: six quick counts to a bar, felt as two big sways. Count 1 2 3, 4 5 6, and lean on 1 and 4.
rows.translation: Tämä soutulaulu on kuusikahdeksasosatahdissa: kuusi nopeaa laskua tahdissa, tuntumana kaksi suurta keinahdusta. Laske 1 2 3, 4 5 6 ja painota lukuja 1 ja 4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In six-eight, where do the big beats fall?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On every count
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On 1, 3 and 5
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On 1 and 4
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Six eighths group in two threes: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. The first of each three carries the sway.
rows.translation: Kuusi kahdeksasosaa ryhmittyy kahdeksi kolmikoksi: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. Jokaisen kolmikon ensimmäinen kantaa keinunnan.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: No new ideas: four songs, counted in, kept going and finished clean. Play them back to back like a short concert.

rows.source: Hello, bass
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 “Hello, bass” · title

rows.source: Meet E A D G, pluck with two fingers, play your first notes and a song.
rows.translation: Tutustu säveliin E A D G, näppäile kahdella sormella ja soita ensisävelet sekä kappale.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 “Hello, bass” · unit summary

rows.source: Meet your bass
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · title

rows.source: Four strings, low and deep
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 4.
rows.translation: Paksuin kieli soi matalimmalta. Soittaessa se on lähimpänä kasvojasi. Kutsumme sitä kieleksi 4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which string is string 4?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (4).
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G. They match the four lowest guitar strings, an octave down. Try: Every Amp Drives Grooves.
rows.translation: Paksusta ohueen: E, A, D, G. Ne vastaavat kitaran neljää alinta kieltä oktaavia alempana. Muistisääntö: Eilen Aamulla Dinosaurus Groovasi.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-2 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
